# openmetadata_team (Data Source)

Fetches an OpenMetadata Team by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_team" "data_engineering" {
  name = "DataEngineering"
}

output "team_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_team.data_engineering.id
}

output "team_type" {
  value = data.openmetadata_team.data_engineering.team_type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the team to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the team.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `domains` (List of String) Fully qualified names of domains this team belongs to.
- `email` (String) Email address of the team.
- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the team.
- `id` (String) UUID of the team.
- `is_joinable` (Boolean) Whether users can self-join this team.
- `owners` (Attributes List) Owners of this team. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))
- `parents` (List of String) Fully qualified names of parent teams.
- `policies` (List of String) Fully qualified names of policies attached to this team.
- `team_type` (String) Type of the team (Group, Department, Division, BusinessUnit, Organization).

<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) UUID of the owner entity.
- `type` (String) Type of the owner (user or team).
